The Receiving Party shall implement and strictly enforce access controls, role-based permissions, encryption protocols, password protection practices, secure storage environments, and multi-factor authentication mechanisms whenever storing or processing Confidential Information. The Receiving Party shall refrain from uploading Confidential Information to unauthorized cloud environments, personal email accounts, personal devices, or unvetted third-party systems. Any replication or backup of Confidential Information, if permitted, must be stored in equivalently secure environments, ensuring that confidentiality is preserved at all times. In the event that any breach, suspected breach, or unauthorized access incident is detected, the Receiving Party shall notify the Disclosing Party without delay, provide a detailed explanation of the incident, cooperate fully in investigating the cause, and implement corrective actions to mitigate risk of recurrence.
